import pygame

import sys

import random

# 1. Initialize Pygame setup

pygame.init()

# 2. Extreme Difficulty Game Parameters

SCREEN_WIDTH = 400

SCREEN_HEIGHT = 600

GRAVITY = 0.75 # Heavy gravity makes the bird drop instantly

FLAP_STRENGTH = -11.5 # Sharp, powerful upward jump to combat heavy gravity

PIPE_SPEED = 9 # Double the standard speed; pipes rush across the screen

PIPE_GAP = 95 # Extremely narrow opening to squeeze through (Extreme Mode)

# 3. Window & Clock Configuration

screen = pygame.display.set_mode((SCREEN_WIDTH, SCREEN_HEIGHT))

pygame.display.set_caption("Extreme Flappy Bird")

clock = pygame.time.Clock()

# 4. State Variables

bird_y = 300

bird_velocity = 0

score = 0

game_active = True

# 5. Visual Colors (RGB)

DEEP_RED = (139, 0, 0) # Changing background to red for extreme mode

WHITE = (255, 255, 255)

BIRD_YELLOW = (255, 223, 0)

PIPE_DARK = (40, 40, 40) # Dark pipes for an aggressive theme

def create_pipe():

"""Generates a top and bottom pipe configuration with an extremely tight gap."""

center_y = random.randint(180, 420)

top_pipe = pygame.Rect(SCREEN_WIDTH, 0, 65, center_y - (PIPE_GAP // 2))

bottom_pipe = pygame.Rect(SCREEN_WIDTH, center_y + (PIPE_GAP // 2), 65, SCREEN_HEIGHT)

return top_pipe, bottom_pipe

# Initialize with the first pipe pair

pipes = [create_pipe()]

font = pygame.font.Font(None, 40)

# 6. Core Engine Loop

while True:

for event in pygame.event.get():

    if event.type == pygame.QUIT:

        pygame.quit()

        sys.exit()

    

    if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:

        if event.key == pygame.K_SPACE and game_active:

            bird_velocity = FLAP_STRENGTH

        if event.key == pygame.K_SPACE and not game_active:

            \# Reset game state to start over

            game_active = True

            pipes = \[create_pipe()\]

            bird_y = 300

            bird_velocity = 0

            score = 0

if game_active:

    \# Calculate fast gravity physics

    bird_velocity += GRAVITY

    bird_y += bird_velocity

    bird_rect = pygame.Rect(100, int(bird_y), 28, 28) # Slightly smaller hitbox for tight gaps

    \# Move obstacle pipes extremely quickly to the left

    for top_pipe, bottom_pipe in pipes:

        top_pipe.x -= PIPE_SPEED

        bottom_pipe.x -= PIPE_SPEED

    \# Spawn new obstacle pipes much closer to each other

    if pipes\[-1\].x \< SCREEN_WIDTH - 160:

        pipes.append(create_pipe())

    \# Clean up off-screen items & increment score safely

    if pipes\[0\].top_pipe.x \< -65:

        pipes.pop(0)

        score += 1

    \# Evaluate crash conditions with borders

    if bird_y \<= 0 or bird_y \>= SCREEN_HEIGHT - 28:

        game_active = False

    \# Evaluate crash conditions with pipes

    for top_pipe, bottom_pipe in pipes:

        if bird_rect.colliderect(top_pipe) or bird_rect.colliderect(bottom_pipe):

            game_active = False

\# 7. Render frames on screen

screen.fill(DEEP_RED)

for top_pipe, bottom_pipe in pipes:

    pygame.draw.rect(screen, PIPE_DARK, top_pipe)

    pygame.draw.rect(screen, PIPE_DARK, bottom_pipe)

bird_rect = pygame.Rect(100, int(bird_y), 28, 28)

pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, BIRD_YELLOW, bird_rect)

\# Render ongoing score layout

score_txt = font.render(f"Score: {score}", True, WHITE)

screen.blit(score_txt, (15, 15))

if not game_active:

    msg_txt = font.render("IMPOSSIBLE! Space to Retry", True, WHITE)

    screen.blit(msg_txt, (25, SCREEN_HEIGHT // 2 - 20))

pygame.display.update()

clock.tick(60)  # Updates game frames precisely 60 times a second
